notes: SEED. Written by hand, and the only hand-written index there will ever be:
once this directory is extracted into `ade-plugins-registry` (README,
'Extraction') the crawler owns this file and hand edits are overwritten.
It carries the plugins ADE bundles, so an install with no network still
recognises them by id. What it deliberately does NOT carry is anything the
crawler would have measured: no install counts, no stars, no published or
updated dates. An omitted count renders as nothing; a zero would render as a
measurement, and nobody has measured these.
`repo` names the repository each plugin will be published at. Those
repositories do not exist yet — the packages currently live in this
repository under `plugins/`, and the Marketplace installs them from the copy
bundled in the app. Until the org is published, an install driven from THIS
file would have nothing to clone.
